content: Trigger: Geyser/mempool detects pump.fun bonding-curve completion + immediate Raydium pool creation with ≥8 SOL initial liquidity. Action: Submit Jito bundle buy in the same block targeting 0.3–0.8 SOL size. Risk: Abort if freeze or mint authority remains enabled.

Trigger: Same-block liquidity addition detected via Yellowstone gRPC on Raydium AMM or pump.swap with >15 SOL depth. Action: Execute market buy with 8–12% priority fee multiplier. Risk: Cap position at 0.6% of capital; exit if first 3 slots show no volume expansion.
Trigger: Freeze authority still set to creator after migration. Action: Hard filter — do not enter. Risk: Even if liquidity looks locked, freeze enables permanent transfer blocks.
Trigger: Mint authority retained by creator post-launch. Action: Immediate reject. Risk: Unlimited supply inflation can nuke price in <30 seconds.
Trigger: Token has transfer hooks or restricted transfer program IDs. Action: Blacklist. Risk: Can brick sells even with open liquidity.
Trigger: Creator wallet previously launched ≥2 tokens that rugged within 10 minutes. Action: Permanent filter on this deployer. Risk: Reputation is the strongest pre-filter on Solana.
Trigger: Creator begins selling >5% of holdings in any single transaction within first 4 minutes. Action: Full exit. Risk: Creator sells are the highest-conviction rug signal on Solana.
Trigger: 1-minute volume drops below 25% of the entry-minute volume while price is still above entry. Action: Exit remaining position. Risk: Volume death precedes most 5-minute collapses.

Trigger: Price reaches +100% from entry. Action: Activate trailing stop at 28–35% drawdown from peak (higher than EVM due to Solana volatility). Risk: Tighter trails get wicked out by normal 20–25% wicks.
Trigger: No +20% move within 5 minutes of entry. Action: Time-based full exit. Risk: Dead launches rarely recover on 15s–5m timeframe; capital is better redeployed.

Trigger: Need same-block inclusion against competing snipers. Action: Construct Jito bundle with tip calibrated to current competition (0.01–0.05 SOL base + dynamic). Risk: Under-tipping loses the block; over-tipping destroys edge on small capital.
Trigger: Any open position. Action: Maximum single position size = 0.5–0.8% of total capital. Risk: Larger sizes amplify both ruin and opportunity cost on micro-capital accounts.
Trigger: 4 consecutive losing snipes or daily drawdown >8%. Action: Circuit-breaker pause for 45–90 minutes. Risk: Continues trading only after cooldown and regime re-evaluation.
Trigger: Network congestion (elevated failed TX rate or TPS stress). Action: Pause new snipes. Risk: Failed or delayed transactions turn edge negative.
Trigger: Need to land buy in target block. Action: Prefer Jito bundles over pure priority fees when competition is high. Risk: Bundles have higher inclusion reliability for same-block targeting.
Trigger: Any potential entry. Action: Require both mint and freeze authority renounced (or set to null) before capital is risked. Risk: Non-negotiable filter; everything else is secondary.
Trigger: Detected honeypot simulation failure on sell path. Action: Immediate blacklist. Risk: On-chain simulation of sell is mandatory pre-entry filter.

Trigger: Jito tip market heating up. Action: Cap maximum tip at level where edge remains positive after fees. Risk: Chasing inclusion at any cost turns profitable strategy into fee farm for validators.
Trigger: Slippage on simulated buy exceeds 18% even with small size. Action: Skip. Risk: Indicates either too little liquidity or already-moving price — both poor for micro-capital snipes.

Trigger: Specific KB unit shows negative attributed P&L across ≥30 closed trades with statistical significance. Action: Flag unit for pruning or priority demotion in next RAG cycle. Risk: Retaining losing units systematically degrades decision quality.

Trigger: Trade close event. Action: Attribute realized P&L (net of tips/fees) proportionally to the top-K KB units retrieved at decision time. Risk: Without clean attribution the knowledge base cannot self-improve.

Trigger: First 3 blocks after liquidity addition show ≥40 unique organic signers with no single wallet >8% of volume. Action: Full-size same-block or next-block entry. Risk: Exit if organic inflow collapses in blocks 4–6.

Trigger: Exit required on thin liquidity (<4 SOL depth remaining). Action: Split sell across 2–3 consecutive slots at 30–40% of remaining size each. Risk: Single-slot market sells on thin pools produce catastrophic slippage.

Trigger: Position closed at a loss. Action: Enforce 3-minute cool-down before any re-entry on the same mint; never revenge-trade the same token. Risk: Immediate re-entries after losses have the lowest expectancy of any action on this timeframe.
